findings.title: E02 bounded-process and cleanup claims are false
findings.observation: A 10ms requested timeout ran for 1004.7ms; 288893 bytes were captured without a quota; children_reaped=true was returned while a background child was alive.
findings.required_correction: Use monotonic deadlines, capped stdout/stderr capture, process-group TERM/KILL and observed waitpid reaping; add timeout, output-limit and grandchild-cleanup tests.

findings.title: E02 is task-special-cased rather than a strict generic harness
findings.observation: runner.verify exercises the unknown-operation fallback; strict fixture decoding, recursive expectation comparison, command/dependency allowlists and the mandated negative matrix are absent.
findings.required_correction: Decode the exact fixture schema, reject unknown/missing fields, dispatch typed allowlisted adapters and compare complete observations generically.

findings.title: E03 admits fixture aliases without evidence
findings.observation: Equal nonempty fake receipt aliases with required fields omitted and an extra unknown field produced admitted=true, status=ADMITTED and exit_code=0; the Gleam evaluator exists only in a test file.
findings.required_correction: Validate distinct runtime and formal receipt contents, signatures, hashes and candidate IDs in production code; run removal, candidate-change and measured-input mutants against that code.

findings.title: E03 leaves constant production verification and false-green CLI paths
findings.observation: The two required production verification modules are unchanged; fixed metrics and hardcoded True/PASS values remain. Doctor printed 84 PASS claims and exited 0 without evaluating receipts.
findings.required_correction: Replace constants and file-presence credit with shared typed evidence decisions consumed by CLI, UI and API; missing denominators or receipts must be nonpassing.

findings.title: E01 fabricates unavailable observations and grants signature credit by alias equality
findings.observation: An arbitrary alias/alias fixture produced SUPPORTED and signature_credit=true; unavailable chrony/tool probes receive nominal or version defaults, while source_writes and record presence are constants.
findings.required_correction: Represent probe failures explicitly, bind concrete full candidate IDs, observe source state, and keep signature credit false unless the existing cryptographic approval authority verifies a current signed context.

findings.title: Receipts are non-atomic, incomplete and not bound to the final candidate
findings.observation: Duration is fixed at 12.5ms; writes are direct; required hashes, limits, raw observations and built/executed/passed states are absent. Committed E01/E02/E03 receipts bind three intermediate commits, none 6eadde49. CLI fallback reads mutable canonical main from an isolated workspace.
findings.required_correction: Bind an explicit workspace/candidate, record monotonic measured duration and complete provenance, write via temp-file plus rename, enforce a closed schema, and eliminate the mutable-main fallback.
